subject: Co-sell trigger thresholds and demo-exemption request — Aurora Integrations
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <pshah@aurorasoft.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partnership pilot — co-sell triggers and demo exemption

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Aurora's platform maps nicely to a number of Redwood use cases. Our GTM lead, Arjun (cc'd), asked me to share a quick proposal for how we pilot a co-sell arrangement and an ask we can table up front: a limited "demo-exemption" for low-touch prospects so we don't need full joint-led technical demos for small proof-of-value trials.

High-level asks:
- 12-week pilot where Aurora gets a 12% revenue-share on bookings we bring that convert within 6 months.
- For inbound leads under $25k ARR, allow a demo-exemption so Aurora can run a short POC without Redwood engineering present (we'll use the Aurora self-hosted connector).
- Lead registration window: 60 days from initial Aurora intro to qualify for co-sell credit.

I've attached a short SOW and a one-page summary. Can you confirm whether Redwood would accept the demo-exemption for low-ticket deals, and if the registration window/tiered revenue-share sounds workable?

Best,
Priyanka
Head of Partnerships, AuroraSoft
Attachment: Aurora_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Priyanka Shah <pshah@aurorasoft.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partnership pilot — co-sell triggers and demo exemption

Thanks Priyanka — good to see the outline. I'm supportive of piloting this but want to confirm a few internal guardrails before we commit:

Summary of what we heard (so we're aligned):
- Pilot length: 12 weeks.
- Revenue-share: 12% on bookings introduced by Aurora that close within 6 months.
- Demo-exemption: for inbound deals <$25k ARR, Aurora may run their POC without Redwood engineering.
- Lead registration window: 60 days.

A few clarifying questions / internal asks from Redwood:
1) Risk cap: we typically require a $50k per-quarter cap on retroactive credits during pilots — can Aurora accept a cap to limit financial exposure?
2) Demo-exemption controls: Aurora must follow the Redwood demo-playbook for self-serve connectors (audit logs enabled, restricted API keys, data retention policy applied). We'll include the checklist as an appendix.
3) Lead validation: registrations must include the initial email thread or a HubSpot record id. We'll validate in HubSpot against the contact/company created date.

Next steps from Redwood: Camila (cc) will draft a co-sell appendix for legal review. Karthik, please confirm routing and how we'll attribute demo-exempt deals for commission. Priyanka — if this all looks OK, I'll ask Legal to draft an appendix and a short MSA addendum.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Priyanka Shah <pshah@aurorasoft.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partnership pilot — co-sell triggers and demo exemption

Thanks — quick draft comments from GTM/legal perspective. I'm attaching a working term-sheet (.docx) that folds Priyanka's asks into Redwood templates. Key changes I propose:

- Commission structure: convert to tiered payout to encourage larger deals: 12% for <$50k ARR, 9% for $50k-$200k, 6% for >$200k (paid on first-year ARR).
- Retroactive credit cap: a $50k cap during the pilot period (as Neha suggested).
- Demo-exemption: allow for deals <$25k but require Aurora provide the POC report template and enable audit logging for the connector. Redwood retains right to step in for any security/incident events.
- Lead registration: 60 days, but registrations must include HubSpot record link and brief qualification notes (one-liner: primary use case + estimated buyer persona).

Attachment: co-sell-term-sheet-draft.docx (Word, 64KB)

Questions for Priyanka:
- Can Aurora accept the tiered rates?
- Will your team complete the POC report after each demo-exempt engagement so Redwood can monitor quality?

Camila Reyes
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, Priyanka Shah <pshah@aurorasoft.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partnership pilot — co-sell triggers and demo exemption

Looping in channel routing details — short bullet items so product ops can implement quickly:

- Lead source tagging: Aurora leads go into HubSpot with source = "partner_aurorasoft" and should include UTM_partner=Aurora.
- Attribution: first-touch wins for registration credit; if the lead later engages Redwood SDRs, we'll flag the original registration so revenue credit flows to Aurora per the tiers.
- Demo-exempt deals: label as "aurora_exempt_demo" in HubSpot and include POC report PDF in attachments for audit.
- Validation window: 60 days from initial intro — after that, standard pipeline rules apply.
- Reporting cadence: bi-weekly sync for the pilot (shared Google Sheet + HubSpot dashboard).

I'll have ops create the HubSpot field and a simple checklist in Confluence. Neha / Camila — if you want, I can draft the small-routing playbook and share by EOD tomorrow.

—Karthik
GTM Ops | Redwood Inference

Perfect — this is all very reasonable. Aurora accepts the $50k retro cap for the pilot and we can deliver the POC report after each demo-exempt engagement. We reviewed the tiered rates internally and can accept the proposed tiers.

Next steps from Aurora:

- We will add the HubSpot record ids for our current pipeline and share the first batch by tomorrow.

Thanks — we'll also attach the Aurora demo-playbook for your ops team.

Priyanka
